A little about me

Curious about data. Focused on impact.

Combining analytical thinking with practical tools to help teams understand performance and make informed decisions.

I'm an aspiring Data Analyst with a Bachelor's degree in Information Technology and hands-on practice in Excel, SQL, Power BI, and Python. I work across the data workflow — from cleaning and transforming datasets to exploring trends, tracking KPIs, and presenting findings through clear visualizations.

My goal is to turn business questions into measurable analysis and easy-to-understand reports. I'm continuously building projects that strengthen my analytical, technical, and communication skills.
